name: Farcaster Hub (direct)
description: Direct access to Farcaster's peer-to-peer Hub network via the Hub gRPC/HTTP API. Bypasses Neynar's managed abstraction layer — the operator runs their own Hub node or connects directly to a public Hub. Significant operational overhead; only warranted when Neynar pricing becomes prohibitive at scale.

ecosystem_fit.notes: The underlying infrastructure that Neynar abstracts. Direct Hub access gives full data control and removes per-API-call pricing — at the cost of running and maintaining a Hub node.
Farcaster data only — no Base chain data.

common_pairings.context: Neynar abstracts Hub complexity with a managed API. Direct Hub is the cost-optimized alternative for teams that have reached Neynar's pricing ceiling and have the operational capacity to run their own infrastructure.

trust_evidence.description: The Farcaster Hub protocol is the foundational Farcaster infrastructure maintained by the Farcaster team. Hubble is the canonical reference implementation.
Farcaster protocol documentation covers Hub API, gRPC interface, and self-hosting guides.

scale_guidance.hackathon: Never — use Neynar. Direct Hub adds operational complexity with no hackathon benefit.
scale_guidance.mvp: Never — use Neynar. Hub direct is a premature optimization at MVP scale.
scale_guidance.production: Only when Neynar pricing is confirmed to be unsustainable at your traffic volume. Requires running and maintaining a Hub node or using a public Hub with reliability caveats.

alternatives.when_to_prefer: Default for all Farcaster apps. Managed API with webhooks, search, feed algorithms, and write APIs. Only graduate to direct Hub if Neynar pricing becomes a confirmed business problem.

anti_patterns: Using direct Hub instead of Neynar at MVP scale — operational complexity far outweighs cost savings at low volume.

Assuming direct Hub gives write access — Hubs store and replicate data, but writes require signing with a user's Farcaster key. Write operations still require Neynar's managed signer or direct key management.
Using direct Hub for real-time webhook-style triggers — Hub event subscriptions via gRPC require persistent connections. Neynar's webhook delivery is far simpler to operate.
